<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Complaint" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/complaint">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Complaint" name="Complaint"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Decision" name="Complaint decision"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Refund" name="Refund"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Feedback" name="Customer feedback"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Complaint">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Complaint" name="Files complaint" sourceRef="Task_FileComplaint" targetRef="Start_Complaint" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Decision" name="Notifies decision" sourceRef="Task_NotifyDecision" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision" messageRef="Message_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Refund" name="Provides refund" sourceRef="Task_ProcessReimbursement" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRefund" messageRef="Message_Refund"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Feedback" name="Provides feedback" sourceRef="Task_ProvideFeedback" targetRef="Participant_Company" messageRef="Message_Feedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer complaint interactions" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Ready to file a complaint"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_FileComplaint" name="File complaint"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDecision" name="Receive complaint decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerDecision" name="Was a refund approved?"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveRefund" name="Receive refund"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerMerge" name="Continue after decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackOptional" name="Provide feedback?">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeedbackYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeedbackNo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ProvideFeedback" name="Provide satisfaction feedback"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackMerge" name="Continue after feedback choice"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Customer" name="Customer interaction complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_FileComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_FileComplaint" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDecision" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Approved" name="Refund approved" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerDecision" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRefund">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">refundApproved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Rejected" name="Refund rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerDecision" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">not refundApproved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRefund" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerMerge" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackOptional"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackOptional" targetRef="Task_ProvideFeedback">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">provideFeedback</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackOptional" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_1" sourceRef="Task_ProvideFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_6" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackMerge" targetRef="End_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Complaint" name="Complaint handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Complaint">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CustomerService" name="Customer service">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Complaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_LogComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RefundApproved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ResolutionMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MarkResolved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Complaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Investigation" name="Relevant department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewDetails</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DetermineValidityAndRefund</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Finance" name="Financial team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessReimbursement</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_RefundReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Complaint" name="Complaint filed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Complaint" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LogComplaint" name="Log complaint"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignComplaint" name="Assign complaint to relevant department"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewDetails" name="Review complaint details"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineValidityAndRefund" name="Determine complaint validity and refund justification"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyDecision" name="Notify customer of decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefundApproved" name="Is a refund approved?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessReimbursement" name="Process reimbursement"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_RefundReceived" name="Customer receives refund"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ResolutionMerge" name="Continue to resolution"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MarkResolved" name="Mark complaint as resolved"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Complaint" name="Complaint resolved"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Complaint_1" sourceRef="Start_Complaint" targetRef="Task_LogComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Complaint_2" sourceRef="Task_LogComplaint" targetRef="Task_AssignComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Complaint_3" sourceRef="Task_AssignComplaint" targetRef="Task_ReviewDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Complaint_4" sourceRef="Task_ReviewDetails" targetRef="Task_DetermineValidityAndRefund"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Complaint_5" sourceRef="Task_DetermineValidityAndRefund" targetRef="Task_NotifyDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Complaint_6" sourceRef="Task_NotifyDecision" targetRef="Gateway_RefundApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refund_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundApproved" targetRef="Task_ProcessReimbursement">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">refundApproved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refund_Rejected" name="Rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundApproved" targetRef="Gateway_ResolutionMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">not refundApproved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Complaint_7" sourceRef="Task_ProcessReimbursement" targetRef="Event_RefundReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Complaint_8" sourceRef="Event_RefundReceived" targetRef="Gateway_ResolutionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Complaint_9" sourceRef="Gateway_ResolutionMerge" targetRef="Task_MarkResolved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Complaint_10" sourceRef="Task_MarkResolved" targetRef="End_Complaint"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
